item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
Likely 0.2.0

Faster, smarter searches

- A rewritten search prompt: fewer steps, quicker first results, and better at "my …" requests like your photo or resume.

- Uses Spotlight details (transparency, image size, download source, dates) instead of opening files one by one.

Make it your own

- New Tools tab: add command-line tools your agent can use (approve each one), and turn built-in tools on or off.

- Search history in Settings, which you can turn off.

Privacy

- Likely's data files are readable only by you, and search history is encrypted with a key in your Keychain.

- Photos, Mail, Messages and other private data are off-limits to the agent by default, with switches to allow them.

- No screenshots are stored, and logs leave out what you search for.

Polish

- Recent files skip files apps write in the background.

- A short demo on the first onboarding screen, and a "Likely is running" note when setup finishes.

- A simpler menu bar, plus Terms and Privacy links.

- Updates now come from GitHub Pages.
